name: ModelVariant401_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant401_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (header 416's entry with one 0x27C-byte band of nine columns, two sheets, a fifth texture and no burst threshold); for a non-negative request it selects the config at data + 0xFC indexed by the request, gets the slot parts and packs five texture images, otherwise it runs one frame (sheets and webs from the config start, the band while the phase is positive, rays from phase 2) and returns 4 in phases 2-4, then 1 once and 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in the model-410 stage-9/10 images of every region except the Spanish two (the Spanish entry is still generated assembly); the French header-418/568 images build it from the same source with palette x 640. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
